ShortDescription.Value: Progressive job seeking for small cities

Publish.LongDescription:
Please report bugs in the discussion section/forum.
In the original game, 100 open jobs matching a citizen's education level or lower are required for a 100% chance that the citizen will apply for a job. With only one suitable open position, the chance is just 1%, and the citizen may instead become a student and travel to an outside connection to study.
This mod changes that behaviour progressively. For cities with a population below a configurable milestone, the application chance is 100%. As the population grows, the required number of available jobs gradually increases in configurable increments, eventually reaching the vanilla behaviour.
**Both Milestone and Increment can be configured in the game options.**
**Default settings:** 100 population / 10%
### Additional features
- Displays a citizen's work hours in the Selected Info panel. - Displays the household's resource purchases from the previous month in the Household Info panel. - Added PrioritizeAdultEmployment checkbox in options. This prevents employed adults from deciding to leave their job to study. Vanilla behaviour is restored progressively as the city grows. - Added a "Looking for work" message for followed citizens, including the number of suitable positions and positions matching their education level. - Added AcceptLowerJobs checkbox in options. This reduces the vanilla penalty for accepting jobs below a citizen's education level in smaller cities. Vanilla behaviour is restored progressively as the city grows. - Fixed the CitizenFindJobSystem double-counting of available workplaces for unemployed citizens: https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/citizenfindjobsystem-double-counts-available-workplaces-for-unemployed-citizens.1940269/

ChangeLog.Value: Added AcceptLowerJobs option, fixed available-workplace double counting, and added more information to the Looking for work message.
